basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old expat living in Zurich, originally from the UK. I've been a Redditor for over five years and love using it to keep up with the latest tech trends and DIY repair tips. During the day, I work as a customer service manager in a multinational company, which keeps me quite busy. In my free time, I enjoy tinkering with gadgets, hiking in the Swiss Alps, and exploring local cuisines with my partner. I’m generally online in the evenings and weekends. I’m fascinated by languages, though my German is still a work in progress!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in customer service and management, with over a decade of experience. I studied business administration at university and have a keen interest in technology and DIY projects. I often self-teach through online resources and forums like Reddit, which helps me stay up-to-date with the latest developments in my field.
